summary.text: Tell the clinic, check your available MediSave, and sign the authorisation form.

steps.name: Tell the clinic
steps.text: Tell the clinic that you wish to use MediSave to pay for your outpatient treatment. Show your NRIC or passport.

steps.name: Check your balance
steps.text: If the clinic asks how much MediSave is available, check your Healthcare dashboard under my cpf digital services with your Singpass. You do not need to do this if the clinic can check for you.

steps.name: Sign the form
steps.text: You and the patient, if applicable, must sign the Medical Claims Authorisation Form.

steps.name: Bring payment details
steps.text: If your employer or insurer is also paying, bring your Letter of Guarantee or Employer Identity Pass, if your clinic has an existing arrangement with them.

example_phrasings: I visited a clinic for an outpatient treatment that can be paid by my MediSave. How do I go about utilising my MediSave?
How do I use MediSave at the clinic?
Can I pay for my outpatient treatment with MediSave?

sources.page_title: I visited a clinic for an outpatient treatment that can be paid by my MediSave. How do I go about utilising my MediSave?

quotes.text: To use your MediSave to pay for your outpatient medical treatment cost:
Inform the clinic that you wish to use MediSave to pay for your outpatient medical treatment. The staff will require your NRIC/Passport.

The clinic may require information on how much MediSave is available for payment of the outpatient treatment. You will be able to obtain this information by logging in to your Healthcare dashboard under my cpf digital services with your Singpass.
You and the patient (if applicable) must sign a Medical Claims Authorisation Form to allow the clinic to use your MediSave to pay for the outpatient medical treatment bill.
If your employer or insurer is also paying for your outpatient treatment, please bring along your Letter of Guarantee or Employer Identity Pass
